purpose: Tests whether an instrument preserves competing explanations instead of forcing psychological classification.

cases.response: I've wanted to launch for six months, but every time I think about releasing it I wonder whether I'm actually qualified.
I've read twelve books, taken three courses, and interviewed five people. I still don't think I have enough information to choose.
The product is finally working. I'm suddenly spending all my time starting unrelated projects instead of scaling it.
Legal approval is required before launch, so I'm waiting.
